body:
Related, same root cause (Git for Windows' default `core.autocrlf=true`), both closed:

- #2840 - fixture/golden text read byte-for-byte failed on Windows; fixed by pinning those paths `eol=lf` in `.gitattributes`. That file now pins `crates/*/tests/{golden,recorded,fixtures}/**`, `.mch`, `testdata/**`, `.claude/**`, `.github/**`, tester-kit and example programs - but **not `AGENTS.md`** (or other root/doc `.md` files a test reads).
- #3119 - `ai_guide_calls_match_live_tools_list` split `site/content/guide/automate/ai.md` on an LF pattern; fixed in PR #3147 by normalising line endings in the test.

So this one is the next instance of the same gap. The pattern already used for `.claude/**` would fix it at the source: add `AGENTS.md text eol=lf` (and any other tracked doc a test greps, e.g. `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`) to `.gitattributes`; the test-side normalisation of #3147 is the alternative. Either way, the "Done means" sibling sweep can grep the tests for `include_str!`/`read_to_string` of `.md` files to find the rest.

Measured on a Windows box (bacon, Windows 11, Git 2.56) to find every place this bites, not only `AGENTS.md`:

**Setup:** a fresh clone with Git for Windows' default `core.autocrlf=true`, main `3c597bdd8`. `git ls-files --eol` shows `AGENTS.md`, `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `site/content/guide/reference/troubleshooting.md` and `crates/post/tests/klartext/contour.cnc` as `i/lf w/crlf` with no attribute.

**`cargo xtask gate batch`:** 1105 steps, 7 failed, 51.6 min.

| Failing step | Cause |
|---|---|
| `post suites: script_heidenhain_klartext` - `unsupported_motion_or_missing_setup_data_is_refused` | **CRLF**: the test edits `include_str!("klartext/contour.cnc")` with `.replace("Rapid X 115000 Y 25000 Z 15000\n", "")`; with CRLF nothing is removed, so the "unsafe" stream posts |
| `app suites: docs_troubleshooting` - `troubleshooting_messages_still_exist_in_the_sources` | **CRLF**: the stem `mm (both measured along the tilted tool axis) - raise the clearance height by at least` no longer matches across the line break |
| `app suites: example_catalog` - `catalog_2d_drill_overfeed::{rebuilds,regenerates}` | not CRLF: #3524 (red on Linux too) |
| `ui suites: lib`, `egui_app`, `trace_composite`, `trace_parity` | not CRLF: access violation, #3379 |

(The `AGENTS.md` law test this issue names did not run in the batch tier; it is in the light lane.)

**Fix check:** with `* text=auto eol=lf` applied (in `.git/info/attributes`, then a re-checkout; `core.autocrlf` still `true`) every file above checks out `w/lf`, and both CRLF suites pass: `script_heidenhain_klartext` 23/23, `docs_troubleshooting` 1/1.

**Suggestion for this issue:** one line at the top of `.gitattributes`, `* text=auto eol=lf`, keeping the existing later exceptions (the Agie CRLF goldens `-text`, binary STL). It closes the whole class - including files nobody has found yet - instead of pinning paths one by one (#2840, #3119/PR #3147 were the earlier instances). Done means could become: that default in `.gitattributes` + a Windows `core.autocrlf=true` batch run with no CRLF failures. I raised the effort to `medium` since the Agie exceptions and a renormalize commit need care.

fix on issue/3553-lf-pins · PR #3655 · pinned by the three LF attribute rules (checked with git ls-files --eol on a core.autocrlf=true checkout; no build) · merges when reviewed. Not in this PR: docs_troubleshooting is #3619.
